heroHeadline: Madrid Night 2 — 10-Night Residency Underway at Riyadh Air Metropolitano; Myke Towers Made History on Opening Night
heroSubtitle: Bad Bunny is mid-residency in Madrid, performing Night 2 of 10 at the sold-out Riyadh Air Metropolitano on May 31, 2026 — the largest single-artist concert run in Spanish history (640,000+ projected across 10 nights). Opening night on May 30 drew 64,000 fans and featured the first-ever live performance between Bad Bunny and Myke Towers, joining for 'Adivino' and a medley of their shared catalog. The Bad Bunny x Adidas Ballerina 'Flamboyan' (KI7916, Vivid Red, $120), named after Puerto Rico's iconic flamboyán tree, also dropped on May 30 and sold out via Adidas Confirmed. 'DtMF' holds at No. 1 on Billboard Hot Latin Songs for its 61st consecutive week (chart dated May 30) — the all-time chart record, first set when it surpassed 'Despacito' at week 57 in late April. Spotify monthly listeners have surged to 114.1M on tour momentum. The *Porto Rico* epic film (directed by Residente, co-starring Viggo Mortensen, Edward Norton, and Javier Bardem) remains in pre-production.
